//: Composite indexes these queries need. NOT deployed by the workflow.
`firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes` reconciles the ENTIRE index set:
any index live in the project but missing from this file is deleted. The
project already has indexes predating this file, so deploying it blind would
drop them and break whatever queries depend on them.
Before deploying indexes: open Firebase console -> Firestore -> Indexes, add
every existing composite index to this file, and only then deploy. Until that
merge is done this file is documentation, and a missing index shows up in
production as a failed export with a create-it link in the browser console.

indexes.//: zatcaChain: this tenant's chain head and recent invoices.

//: zatcaExport: a date range for one tenant, paged. invoice_number is in
the sort so the cursor is unambiguous — ordering on timestamp alone
would skip invoices sharing a second, which a busy till produces.

indexes.//: loadArchivedRange: a client's own bills across a date range.
